claim: The pruning likelihood computes the correct marginal character likelihood.
evidence: tests/test_likelihood_oracle.py: 1200 random tiny cases agree with independent enumeration within 1e-9
counterevidence: none; disagreement would fail the gate

claim: The scale move's Jacobian is correct and necessary.
evidence: tests/test_mcmc_exact.py: Gamma target recovered with correct mean/variance; Jacobian-omitted negative control is detectably biased

claim: Missing and absent produce distinct likelihoods and the ascertainment correction matches the selection process.
evidence: tests/test_ascertainment.py: L(missing) > L(absent); analytic p(variable) matches simulated fraction within 0.005

claim: Interrupted chains resume with exact CPU state and no duplicated draws.
evidence: tests/test_recovery.py: resumed run bit-identical to uninterrupted run; corrupt checkpoint rejected

claim: The historical effect of calibration choice remains unresolved.
counterevidence: The prior and rate scale also regularize calendar estimates.

claim: Observed diagnostic draws can reproduce some lexical summaries and miss others.
counterevidence: Chains fail convergence; missingness is fixed by conditioning.

claim: The observed diagnostic runs missed the convergence criteria.
counterevidence: The bounded diagnostic is shorter than the full campaign.

claim: Nominal 90% root-age intervals undercovered in protocol 2.
counterevidence: Short-chain and model effects are not isolated.

claim: The workbench distinguishes sampled root locations from evidence localities.
evidence: docs/results/workbench-browser.json: browser checks and linked screenshot
counterevidence: Root-only export and nonconverged diagnostic draws limit interpretation.

claim: The matched recovery study covered 177 true ages of 200.
counterevidence: The realized coverage fell below the declared 90% target.
scope: matched synthetic model and saved trajectories

claim: Protocol 4 covered 170 of 200 true root ages despite improved root ESS.
counterevidence: The same 200 truths had 177 covered ages under protocol 3. The sampler and budgets changed together.

claim: All twenty observed sensitivity fits completed and missed convergence.
counterevidence: Root-age changes in the saved samples may reflect poor mixing.

claim: The spherical mesh lowered held-out log loss under spherical truth.
counterevidence: The paired interval under region truth spans zero.
scope: fixed known trees and coarse held-out regions
